content:
We are starting a new, nonprofit AI alignment research organization, Sequent Research, bringing together researchers previously on the UK AI Security Institute's Alignment Team, the singular learning theory nonprofit Timaeus, and elsewhere to research how to align artificial superintelligence. More details in our announcement post and associated threads:

  1. https://sequent.org/launch
  2. https://x.com/geoffreyirving/status/2064733320827568231

A big part of the org will be heavy automation of theoretical alignment research, which will include automation of prose mathematics and Lean. This is all semi-automation, not full automation of (dramatically less useful!) Erdős problem-style research: we will be building tooling, context, and other machinery on top of Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents. AI alignment does not consist mostly of formalized problems, so most of the human creative research required is creative definitions and assumptions, but in the course of that definitional work there will be a lot of formalizable subproblems which can be dispatched.

We are hiring! We have job descriptions up for Research Scientist and Research Engineer roles, and would love to talk to people with experience in either related areas of mathematics or Lean formalization specifically. You don't have to know AI alignment: we will teach you.

  • Job descriptions
  • Expression of interest form

Location: Sequent will have a large in-person presence in Berkeley, as well as researchers remote from London, Melbourne, and elsewhere. :flag_united_states::flag_united_kingdom::flag_australia:

In addition, we would like to take care to cement a better relationship between Sequent + AI safety and the mathematical community than has been demonstrated recently by some of the broader AI research ecosystem. This includes helping to arrange sufficient funding not just for applications but also to the core tooling and community infrastructure of Lean, Mathlib, and similar. Some thoughts about that here:

  • https://x.com/geoffreyirving/status/2065013577841279411

Here is a discussion thread for questions and such.
